name: Rohga
title: Descendant of Asher
summary: Rohga was a man from the tribe of Asher, mentioned in 1 Chronicles. He was the son of Shemer and belonged to one of the prominent families in the tribe of Asher. He is primarily known through the genealogies that document the tribes of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Asher
keyEvents.description: Rohga is listed as one of the sons of Shemer in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher. He belonged to a prominent family among the descendants of Asher.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Tribal Leaders of Asher
keyEvents.description: Rohga and his relatives are described as heads of their families, chosen men, and skilled warriors among the tribal leaders of Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Listing of the Tribe of Asher
keyEvents.description: As part of the tribe of Asher, Rohga and his family were counted among the fighting men registered in the genealogical records.

keyEvents.title: Asher's inheritance in the promised land
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Asher, to which Rohga belonged, received its allotted portion in the promised land as part of the land distribution under Joshua.
